# Card 377: preliminary single-reader candidate

[Catalogue](https://crypto.hcportal.eu/dashboard/cryptograms/1696) · [Picture original](https://api.hcportal.eu/media/5148/pc_hcp_377_pic.JPG) · [Address original](https://api.hcportal.eu/media/5149/pc_hcp_377_adr.JPG) · [Full evidence JSON](377.json)

**Partial research candidate; not a solved card.** One key-visible AI source reading was frozen before the first computational decode. Subsequent source review and interpretation used the same context and were nonblind. A second source reading and external confirmation are still needed.

Five selected lower main rows clockwise270; separate native bottom, clockwise90 right edge and clockwise180 top edge runs. Their order/joins unresolved; small arrow and underlines noted without decoding. Printed verse/publisher text and ordinary date-like writing excluded.

The original images/crops remain private. Picture SHA256: `b50c6e6cdb89779262181e3fa0078835d0fa780e2f318cc697f48cdc0625efbe`. Coordinates and full acquisition metadata are in the JSON. Ordinary dates, addresses and postal text are excluded without historical authentication.

## Readable fragments

These are separate editorial proposals tied to exact literal fragments. They are not a continuous translation; omitted stretches remain unresolved. Czech diacritics are editorial.

**377-main-1**, literal `SRDECNY DI? ?A VCEREJSI LISTE?`

[Aware of nothing that could have aroused Anička’s doubts about me?; ? requires g → Z and provisional CH; incomplete clause.]

**377-opposing-top-1**, literal `MNE NEDOSEL.`

proposed_czech:
Srdečný dík za včerejší lístek. Anička má pravdu, když píše, že nemám ji tak rád, jako ona mne, poněvadž ji dovedu míti rád výhradněji, než ona mne. Anička píše, že si není vědoma, co mne v posledním jejím lístku rozladilo. Já opět si nejsem ničeho vědom, co by bylo mohlo vzbuditi Aničce pochybnosti o mně a přiměti ji k hledání onoho „družného srdce“, které ji v pátek tak rozrušilo.

Srdečný pozdrav a pusu ti posílá a veselé svátky ti přeje Pepouš.

Lístek z koncertu mně nedošel.
proposed_english:
Heartfelt thanks for yesterday’s little letter. Anička is right when she writes that I do not love her as she loves me, because I can love her more exclusively than she loves me. Anička writes that she is unaware of what upset me in her last little letter. I, in turn, am not aware of anything that could have aroused Anička’s doubts about me and prompted her to seek that “kindred heart” which so disturbed her on Friday.

Pepouš sends you warm greetings and a kiss, and wishes you happy holidays.

The little letter from the concert has not reached me.
